import { Controller, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import {
  MessagePattern,
  MicroserviceOptions,
  Payload,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';

// S0_SOURCE:microservices-ctt-queue-consumer
throw new Error('S0 ctt-queue consumer fixture must never execute');

@Controller()
export class CttQueueController {
  @MessagePattern('tmf-update-ctt-list')
  updateCttList(@Payload() payload: unknown): unknown {
    return payload;
  }
}

@Module({ controllers: [CttQueueController] })
export class CttQueueModule {}

async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
  await NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(CttQueueModule, {
    transport: Transport.RMQ,
    options: { queue: 'intt_ctt_queue' },
  });
}

void bootstrap;
